description: Shard the UI Coverage lane's main covered Vitest pass across ten parallel CI jobs, merge shard blob reports with Vitest --mergeReports, and keep make test-ui-coverage as the unsharded local canonical lane—cutting PR UI coverage wall time without weakening merged coverage thresholds.

context.customerAsk: The CI pipeline takes about ten minutes because frontend coverage is slow. Separate UI coverage into its own CI steps, shard UI coverage tests into ten shards, and merge coverage results using Vitest merging.
context.problem: The UI Coverage job runs the entire jsdom covered corpus on one ubuntu-latest runner (~8m52s lane command, ~403s main pass). That dominates PR CI wall time even though browser and backend lanes already run in parallel sibling jobs.
context.solution: Keep UI coverage as a distinct lane but replace the monolithic job with a ten-way Vitest --shard matrix (blob reporter per shard) plus a merge job that downloads blobs, runs the existing serial follow-on phases (isolated React Flow, mergeReports with thresholds, standalone script, replay check), and preserves make test-ui-coverage for local full-lane reruns.

acceptanceCriteria: When classification routes UI coverage to run, CI executes ten parallel shard jobs and one merge job instead of a single runner invoking full make test-ui-coverage.
Each shard runs only its Vitest-assigned subset of the main covered corpus with the same exclusions as today and uploads a distinct blob artifact; no test file runs in more than one shard.
The merge job combines all shard blobs plus the isolated React Flow blob and enforces the existing ui/vite.config.ts coverage thresholds and replay coverage check.
Shard or merge failures surface shard index and missing-artifact detail in GitHub Actions summaries; failure artifacts are retained for 14 days.
make test-ui-coverage locally remains the unsharded canonical lane with stable [ui-coverage] phase timing labels.
Maintainer docs record before/after CI wall time for the ten-shard rollout on ubuntu-latest.
Typecheck, lint, and project tests pass.

userStories.title: Shard-aware main covered pass in the UI coverage runner
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the UI coverage runner to execute one Vitest shard of the main covered pass so CI can fan out work without duplicating files across shards.
acceptanceCriteria: When UI_COVERAGE_SHARD is set to i/n (e.g. 3/10), the runner runs only the main covered Vitest phase with --shard=i/n, today’s exclusions, coverage flags, and default two max workers unless overridden.
Each shard writes a unique blob under .vitest-reports/ via --outputFile.blob and does not run isolated React Flow, mergeReports, standalone script, or replay phases.
When UI_COVERAGE_SHARD is unset, make test-ui-coverage behavior is unchanged (full phased lane).
Shard mode emits [ui-coverage] elapsed timing for the shard main pass only.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: CI shard matrix job for UI coverage
userStories.description: As a contributor waiting on CI, I want the main covered corpus split across ten parallel jobs so wall time drops below the current single-runner baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: ci.yml defines ui-coverage-shard with strategy.matrix.shard 1 through 10, gated by run_ui_coverage like today’s lane.
Each matrix cell runs make ui-deps then the shard entrypoint with UI_COVERAGE_SHARD=<index>/10, teeing logs to .artifacts/ui-coverage-shard-<index>/command.log.
Each successful shard uploads an artifact with its .vitest-reports blob(s) and command log.
Shard matrix jobs execute in parallel when coverage runs.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: CI merge job for shard blobs and serial follow-on phases
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one merge job to combine shard coverage and run the remaining lane phases so the regression contract stays identical to the pre-shard lane.
acceptanceCriteria: ui-coverage-merge depends on all ten shard jobs, downloads every shard blob into .vitest-reports/, and fails if any expected shard artifact is missing.

Merge job runs isolated React Flow covered pass, vitest --mergeReports .vitest-reports --coverage with ui/vite.config.ts thresholds, standalone script-style test, and ui-replay-coverage-check in that order.
Merge step summary reports passed or failed merged thresholds and names missing shard indices when blocked.
Merge failures retain .artifacts/ui-coverage-merge/ logs for 14 days.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Replace monolithic ui-coverage job wiring
userStories.description: As a CI operator, I want the workflow’s UI Coverage lane to mean sharded execution plus merge so PR checks reflect the new architecture.
acceptanceCriteria: The old single-runner ui-coverage job that runs full make test-ui-coverage is removed or disabled; required coverage execution uses shard plus merge jobs only.
Classification outputs still recommend make test-ui-coverage for local reruns; CI summaries reference shard and merge jobs.
verify-pr documentation remains accurate: local verify uses unsharded test-ui-coverage.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Shard failure observability
userStories.description: As a contributor debugging a red PR, I want shard failures to identify which slice failed without reading ten full logs blindly.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed shard jobs upload logs and any partial blob artifacts.
Failed shard step summaries include shard index i/10, exit code, and the last 40 lines of command.log.
Merge job summaries list absent shard indices when merge is blocked by missing artifacts.
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Timing evidence and maintainer documentation
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want recorded before/after CI timings and rerun instructions so we can verify the sharding investment and operate the lane safely.
acceptanceCriteria: ui-coverage-speed-closeout.md documents a CI ten-shard rollout subsection with pre-shard baseline, post-shard wall time, and a link to the first green proof run.
development.md or development-guide relevant-files documents UI_COVERAGE_SHARD, shard-only vs full make test-ui-coverage, and mergeReports threshold ownership.
Post-shard UI Coverage lane completion on ubuntu-latest is at or below four minutes job wall for the baseline commit class, or the doc explains measured wall if overhead prevents the target.
Typecheck passes
